name: JevShield AI Anti-Spam for Forms
author: elpx

sections.description:
Tired of losing valuable client leads to annoying CAPTCHAs, or waking up to dozens of SEO sales pitches in your inbox?

JevShield uses ultra-fast semantic AI classification to distinguish genuine inquiries from unsolicited promotional pitches, backlink spammers, and crypto bots without forcing visitors to solve picture puzzles.

  • Zero CAPTCHA: No traffic lights, puzzles, or checkboxes (increases form conversion rate by up to 14%).
  • Semantic Analysis: Detects human-written and AI-generated sales pitches that behavioral CAPTCHAs miss.
  • Fail-Open Reliability: If any network timeout occurs, legitimate messages pass through safely.
  • Compatible Plugins: Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Pro Forms, and Native WordPress Comments.

External Service

This plugin connects to JevShield Cloud API (https://jevshield.com/api/v1/check) to classify submitted form content and protect your website from spam.

  • Service Provider: JevShield Cloud (https://jevshield.com)
  • What data is sent: Only the submitted message text, sender name, and email address are sent over an encrypted HTTPS connection to perform real-time spam scoring. No passwords, IP addresses, or payment fields are sent.
  • Terms of Service: https://jevshield.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://jevshield.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/jevshield-ai-anti-spam/, or upload the ZIP file directly through WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > JevShield AI in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter your JevShield API key (get a free key at https://jevshield.com/account) and save settings.
sections.faq:
Does this require a JevShield account?

Yes. You need an API key from https://jevshield.com to enable cloud semantic spam checks. A free tier with 100 checks per month is available.

What happens if the JevShield API is unavailable?

The plugin uses a fail-open architecture. If the API cannot be reached, the submission is allowed through so you never miss a real customer inquiry.
